concepts.quote: It does not compile, since round gives a long.
concepts.why: Correctly diagnoses the compile-time error in int k2 = Math.round(2.5); by the rule that Math.round(double) returns long, which cannot be stored in an int without a cast.

concepts.quote: does not compile, since round gives a long
concepts.why: Correctly identifies that a long value cannot be assigned to an int without an explicit cast, the exact 'possible lossy conversion from long to int' trigger.
Implicitly relies on the narrowing rule (long to int needs a cast) to explain the failure, but states it only implicitly rather than as a general class of error.
